newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nikkodo, Taikan to cooperate in karaoke business.
newsitem.headline: Nikkodo, Taikan to cooperate in karaoke business.

text.p: Japan's Nikkodo Co Ltd said on Monday it would form a partnership with Taikan Co Ltd covering a wide range of businesses related to karaoke music equipment.
The two firms will share their resources and cooperate in the development, stocking, wholesaling and rental of karaoke music equipment and related products.
They will also seek ways to attract new customers amid growing competition brought on by an oversupply of karaoke facilities, Nikkodo said in a statement.
The business alliance with Taikan will not affect Nikkodo's earnings forecast for the 1997/98 business year, which began April 1, Nikkodo said.
